lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed a spurious closeIssueOnMain regression for github/linear backends. Root cause: finalizeCycleClose called stashFn(issueId) unconditionally whenever issueId !== null, regardless of issueSystem. The sidecar then passed closeIssueId: state.issueId to runPostMerge with no backend gate, causing a not-found error on the none-backend store for github/linear projects. Fix: gated stashFn behind issueSystem === 'none' in ship-finalize.ts line 155. Two new test assertions added to AC5 (github+linear) to catch this regression in future. file-size budget raised: test/ship-finalize.test.ts 507->541 (ref: CAM-121 US-R1-001). check:all green (2759 pass).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story is a pure in-house bug fix in ship-finalize.ts. No external library exercised.
